label: Version 1.3.8
releaseNotes: Limits Referral Files uploads to DEV, PPD, and SQA; PROD remains available only in the separate LEIE workflow.
Shows clearer activity messages for scanning, validating, processing, packaging, connection testing, uploading, diagnostics, completion, and errors.
Displays file or server counts and percentages when totals are known, plus visible in-progress feedback during steps without a numeric total.
Includes the internally released Version 1.3.7 improvements for referral-derived ICNs, unique Referral Numbers, multi-station assignment, and iFAMS naming.
Includes the Version 1.3.7 responsiveness improvements and Electron 44 dependency update.
